post_title: Agent Tool Design Belongs in Your Harness Audit, Not Prompt Tips
description: Captures or reads an MCP server's tools/list output, flags write tools with no idempotency-key parameter, destination parameters (to, recipient, url, channel, account) left as free strings, and missing or contradictory annotations, then locks definitions plus the exact code pin and prints a labelled BREAKING/WIDENING/REVIEW diff on upgrade, marking the implementation change UNDETERMINED because a definition hash cannot see server code
